data.name: Andrew
data.gender_notes: Andrew is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek andreios, 'manly, brave', from anēr, 'man'. Its root is Greek anēr (ἀνήρ). Andrew the Apostle, brother of Peter. Andrew is a Greek name meaning “Manly; brave”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Andrew expresses “Manly; brave”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Greek andreios, 'manly, brave', from anēr, 'man'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Andrew total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
